Benjamin Schmolck: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Benjamin Schmolck (1672–1737) · Hymn writer

4 hymns on NoteFusion credit Benjamin Schmolck. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • My Jesus, as Thou Wilt

    My Jesus, as Thou wilt!

    Doh is Eb4/4Tune: JEWETTSolfa PDF

  • Open Now Thy Gates of Beauty

    Open now thy gates of beauty,

    Doh is Bb4/4Tune: UNSER HERRSCHERSolfa PDF

  • Welcome, Thou Victor in the Strife

    Welcome, Thou Victor in the strife,

    Doh is G3/4Tune: ST. AGNESSolfa PDF

  • What Our Father Does Is Well

    What our Father does is well:

    Doh is Ab4/4Tune: SPANISH HYMNSolfa PDF
